description: K₂NaGdCl₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. K is bonded to twelve equivalent Cl atoms to form distorted KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent GdCl₆ octahedra. All K-Cl bond lengths are 3.81 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GdCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.74 Å. Gd is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form GdCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Gd-Cl bond lengths are 2.66 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Gd atom.
